title: Insight Partners’ Deven Parekh on why the firm is diversifying while everyone else bets the farm on OpenAI and Anthropic
slides: Why is Insight Partners backing non-AI startups?
Deven Parekh says the firm is diversifying its bets.
But Insight still invests in AI—just not exclusively.
Founders can now attract capital beyond AI hype.
Ask: Is your startup too dependent on one trend?
thread_text:
1. AI hype is cooling

Insight Partners just backed non-AI startups, proving that trend-agnostic bets are back on the table.

2. Diversifying the bet

Deven Parekh says the firm is spreading its chips across sectors, so AI no longer hogs the entire cap table.

3. AI still in the mix

Insight hasn't abandoned AI—it just refuses to make it the only item on the menu.

4. Founders get leverage

Without a pure AI pitch, you can now attract capital by solving a real problem, not just riding a wave.

5. Is your startup a one-trick pony?

If your entire story collapses when AI hype fades, you're not a business—you're a bet. Test that this week.
